info.name: Paura e delirio a Las Vegas
info.plot: Due tossicodipendenti sono in viaggio con la macchina verso Las Vegas. Tra pasticche, alcol e siringhe distruggeranno vari alberghi e rischieranno guai seri con la polizia, tutto in un'atmosfera tutt'altro che drammatica, anzi esilarante, farsesca e confusa dovuta agli effetti delle varie droghe.

translations.overview: Raoul Duke and his attorney Dr. Gonzo drive a red convertible across the Mojave desert to Las Vegas with a suitcase full of drugs to cover a motorcycle race. As their consumption of drugs increases at an alarming rate, the stoned duo trash their hotel room and fear legal repercussions. Duke begins to drive back to L.A., but after an odd run-in with a cop, he returns to Sin City and continues his wild drug binge.
translations.tagline: Buy the ticket, take the ride.
